name: Naomi Tears
source:
This is a Snoot Game fork, this game shows an alternative route from the game.

Here Naser breakup with Naomi a week before Anon's arrival at Volcadera. Get into this history full of drama, sadness and emotion as the original game, this time with a little bit of clasism sprinkled over.

[From [url=https://kuroshima60.itch.io/naomi-tears]itch.io[/url]]

Based on the short fanfiction story ¿Quién secará mis lagrimas cuando mi mundo se desmorone?.
